description: Use when you need facts about the site itself rather than a fix list. Set view: health (0-100 score with its four penalties), status (recent runs, changes, priorities and GSC archive in one call), update_impact (one Google update crossed with this site; pass updateId), worklog (what previous rounds changed; limit/offset), profile (structured business profile: model, offers, audiences, markets, revenue pages), crawler_gaps (paths AI crawlers asked for that 404 or are blocked), asn (traffic grouped by network with tiered evidence), asn_detail (one ASN's 7/30/90-day history; pass asn). For findings use get_audit, for the ranked fix list use get_opportunities, for one page use get_evidence or get_page_report.

historyDays.description: History window for daily rows, top paths and UA pool; the tier is always judged on yesterday + today

radarDays.description: Only radar updates published within this many days

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.
